title: How to do pull-ups for SIZE
summary: NH explains 'bodybuilding pull-ups': range of motion and technique chosen for lat and upper back hypertrophy rather than calisthenics competition standards. The captions are garbled machine-translated noise, so this note rests mainly on the description and the few recoverable fragments (no objective full ROM, scapular retraction, not fully extending).
claims: Too many people follow range-of-motion dictates for pull-ups that they don't understand
To hypertrophy the lats, do 'bodybuilding pull-ups' with technique and ROM chosen for growth
Bodybuilding pull-ups are the only vertical pull you need for upper back development
Calisthenics standards are subjective competition rules for controlling parameters, not optimised hypertrophy principles
There is no such thing as an objectively correct full range of motion; ROM standards come from competition, like squat depth rules
Retract the scapula on pull-ups and avoid hanging fully extended at the bottom, keeping tension on the upper back
exercises: scapular retraction; ROM chosen for lat tension rather than competition dead-hang standards
only vertical pull needed for upper back hypertrophy
